content: I2IT refers to International Institute of Information Technology, Pune.
I2IT is an engineering-focused institute known for technology education, practical learning, and industry-oriented academic activities.
I2IT academic environment includes theory classes, practical labs, project work, and skill-oriented learning.
Common engineering branches served in the website context include IT, CS, and ENTC modules for timetable and updates.
For admission details, users should check official admission notices, eligibility criteria, and deadline updates from institute channels.
Students are advised to keep semester, department, and profile data updated for accurate timetable and academic suggestions.
The academic schedule module is used to view department-wise timetable in a structured table format.
Campus events module provides technical, cultural, and academic event updates along with audience-based visibility.
Hostel module provides occupancy-related information such as room availability and waiting-list status updates.
Placement section helps students track drives, eligibility snapshots, and preparation opportunities.
Faculty directory module helps students identify academic contacts department-wise.
Notification module is used for institute announcements such as deadlines, holidays, and service updates.
Faculty/admin portal supports posting events, posting notifications, and updating timetable rows for departments.
Website role model: students consume information, while faculty/admin publish operational updates.
Users can login/register, maintain student profile, and use personalized AI assistance based on stored profile fields.
If the chatbot does not find relevant campus data, users should ask more specific department or module-focused questions.
If chatbot shows backend connectivity issue, restart the backend API service and retry.
For casual greetings, the assistant can guide users toward timetable, events, hostel, placements, or notifications queries.
